title: Budgeted Robust Intervention Design for Financial Networks with Common Asset Exposures
summary: In the context of containment of default contagion in financial networks, we here study a regulator that allocates pre-shock capital or liquidity buffers across banks connected by interbank liabilities and common external asset exposures. The regulator chooses a nonnegative buffer vector under a linear budget before asset-price shocks realize.
